Mina / team —

I reviewed BrightHealths usage and built two scenarios (attached v2). Summary below — these are customer-facing phrasing suggestions plus the numbers so Mina can paste them into the email: 

Scenario A (Conservative):
- Annual commit ~ 0.88x of their trailing 12-month actuals (protects Redwood from churned over-commit),
- Effective per-token discount: 8% vs current list,
- Smoothing: quarterly true-up with max uplift of 6% QoQ.

Scenario B (Growth-aligned):
- Annual commit ~ 1.05x trailing 12-month actuals (assumes pilot converts),
- Effective per-token discount: 14% vs current list,
- Smoothing: monthly true-up with staged uplifts (2% max MoM step).

Bridge Offer (60 days):
- Maintain current per-token pricing for 60 days with a 10% credit applied to invoices issued in the bridge window if they sign the proposed annual commit within 30 days of the bridge end date.

Notes:
- To hit customers <=12% uplift desire, Scenario B needs the bridge credit and staged uplift to keep measured YoY under 12% in year 1.
- If procurement pushes harder (<10%), we can tighten Scenario A to lower the effective uplift but it will reduce upfront commit economics.

Ive attached a customer-ready one-pager and an updated workbook: proposed_commit_scenarios_v2.xlsx. Suggested next step: Mina sends the two scenarios plus the bridge offer to procurement and asks for a short call to align on uplift tolerance.

—Aditya

Hi Sarah / procurement team —

Thanks again for the usage file and the guidance on uplift. Per our internal review, attached are two proposed renewal scenarios and a short bridge to buy time while you finalize forecasts. Summary: 

1) Conservative Tier (Scenario A) — recommended if you want minimal near-term spend risk:
- Annual commit: 0.88x trailing 12-month actuals
- Effective per-token discount: 8% off list
- Smoothing: quarterly true-up, max uplift 6% QoQ
- Outcome: Year 1 uplift against current effective spend ~ +6% (below your 12% cap)

2) Growth Tier (Scenario B) — recommended if pilot likely expands:
- Annual commit: 1.05x trailing 12-month actuals
- Effective per-token discount: 14% off list
- Smoothing: monthly staged uplift, 2% max MoM step, with a Jan pilot buffer
- Outcome: With bridge credit applied, measured YoY uplift kept <=12% in Year 1

Bridge Offer (60 days):
- Maintain current per-token rates for 60 days after you sign the engagement memo. Invoices during the bridge will receive a one-time 10% credit if the annual commit is executed within 30 days after the bridge window closes.

Next steps proposed:
- Can procurement confirm whether the 10% bridge credit structure is acceptable?
- If yes, well route a short engagement memo and DocuSign link for the chosen scenario.

Ive included the updated workbook (proposed_commit_scenarios_v2.xlsx) and a one-page summary. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks —
